player_prompt.intro:
Welcome to Frozen Lake!

You are represented by 'P' on the grid.
Grid symbols:
  ' ' = Frozen surface (safe to walk on)
  'H' = Hole (fall in and lose!)
  'G' = Goal (reach this to win!)
  'P' = Your current position

Available actions: up, down, left, right (or w, a, s, d)
Type your action as: [up], [down], [left], [right] or [w], [a], [s], [d]

Objective: Navigate from the start (top-left) to the goal (bottom-right) without falling into any holes!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Qindaa'ina dhiheenyaa mala. [up], [down], [left], [right] ykn [w], [a], [s], [d] kan tti fayyadamu.
invalid_move.unknown_action: Hojii hin beekamne '{action}'. ol, gadii, bitaa, mirgaa ykn w, a, s, d fayyadami.

outcome.fell_in_hole: Hoolaa keessatti arii! Tamsaasaan itti dhufee. Safaroota kee {pct}% tiin guutuun isaa eegale.
outcome.turn_limit: You reached the turn limit! Game over. You completed {pct}% of the journey to the goal.
